evidence: gate output (60/63 ok), perf.js table, screenshots v1-v8 and L1-L7 (parallel version) in the session
lessons: A <button> nested inside the row's <button class=r-main> was silently splitting the row DOM; use <span role=button>.
background-clip:text on a parent with animated inline-block children hides the text; clip on the children.
Line-clamp/ellipsis on mixed RTL/LTR lines mis-cuts; clip by max-height instead.
The repo's scripts cannot run from a cloud chat without attaching the repo; the classifier refuses external code.
Two sessions publishing to one artifact: the publish tool refuses a version not built on the live one and saves the live source; compare both renders before choosing a base, and say so in the report.
Zebra striping must use :nth-child(even of .row) when sticky group headers share the list; plain nth-child(even) flips parity after every header.
A sticky bar with backdrop-filter makes position:fixed children resolve against the bar; drop the blur before using a fixed bottom sheet inside it.
